newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen steady.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen steady.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed up eight paisas at 40.27 to the dollar on Tuesday in the kerb market amid a rise in the supply of the dollar from abroad, dealers said.
They said the rupee was likely to remain stable around the current levels as the demand for the dollar would absorb the rise in the supply.

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on September 10, was 36.9700/37.1549 to the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 9.0 percent, from the previous close at 9.10 percent. - Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
